templates.subtopic: Recognise and label parts of a circle
templates.source: Y10 Foundation Spring B5 Perimeter, area and volume · S5 Recognise and label parts of a circle
templates.text: Ali says that a diameter is a chord. Is he right? Which is the longest chord? Explain.
templates.answer: Yes: a diameter joins two points on the circle, so it is a chord. It is the longest chord, with length [[2 * r]] cm when the radius is [[r]] cm

templates.subtopic: Recognise and label parts of a circle
templates.source: Y10 Foundation Spring B5 Perimeter, area and volume · S5 Recognise and label parts of a circle
templates.text: A circle has a diameter of [[d]] cm. (a) Write down its radius. (b) A chord is [[d - c]] cm long. Is this the longest chord? Explain. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) [[d / 2]] cm  (b) No: the longest chord is the diameter, [[d]] cm

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Spring B5 Perimeter, area and volume · S9 Nets
templates.text: A net has [[n]] triangles and 1 polygon with [[n]] sides. Which solid does it make? How many faces, edges and vertices does it have?
templates.answer: a pyramid whose base has [[n]] sides: [[n + 1]] faces, [[2 * n]] edges, [[n + 1]] vertices

templates.source: Y10 Foundation Spring B5 Perimeter, area and volume · S9 Nets

templates.answer: [[2 * (l * w + l * h + w * h)]] cm²
